character: Compact family resort built for the 1992 Albertville Olympics. Wooded setting between Courchevel and Méribel. Le Farçon ★ Michelin. Quiet, family-friendly.
description: La Tania was built as the athletes' village for the 1992 Albertville Winter Olympics. Compact and car-free, set in a forest clearing at 1,400m. Direct access to both Courchevel and Méribel sectors of the 600km 3V domain. Home to Le Farçon (★ Michelin since 2006, Chef Julien Machet, 9-course tasting menu €180pp, seasonal Savoyard produce) and Bistrot Machet. Free shuttle to Aquamotion (Courchevel — indoor/outdoor pools, slides, spa, climbing wall, indoor surfing, gym). Quiet evening atmosphere — apres limited to a few bars.

non_ski_activities.le_farcon: ★ Michelin since 2006. Chef Julien Machet. Seasonal Savoyard produce, 3 tasting menus, 9-course 'surprise' menu €180pp. Bistrot Machet (brasserie, French classics).
non_ski_activities.aquamotion: Free resort bus to Aquamotion, Courchevel (between 1550 and 1650). Indoor/outdoor pools, 2 large slides, kids area, diving pool, lazy river, power jets. Adults-only spa: 3 saunas, 2 steam rooms, plunge pool, saltwater pool, massages (hot stones, deep tissue, exfoliating). Climbing wall, indoor surfing, gym.
non_ski_activities.ice_skating: Olympic-sized rink at Courchevel 1850 Forum. Disco night Wednesdays 8-10pm.
non_ski_activities.luge_runs: Two dedicated runs: Courchevel Moriond (1650) and 1850 down to 1550 (lit at night).
non_ski_activities.bars_apres: Le Chrome Bar (live music), Pub Le Ski Lodge (big screens, live music), La Taïga (cocktail lounge, food).
non_ski_activities.restaurants: La Ferme de la Tania (slopeside, crepes, fondue, raclette). Telemark (Savoyard). Les Chanterelles (buckwheat crepes). Les Marmottons (pizza, takeaway).
non_ski_activities.other: Cinema, swimming pool at Hotel Le Montana, gym, Chez Nounours kindergarten (from 4 months)
